title: Text built from parts
prompt: The robot's status line reads like "Robo has 100 hp", built from a name and a number.
hints: A number cannot be joined to text directly; str() turns it into text you can join with +.

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings into one. Numbers must be turned into text first.

solution:
func status_line(name, hp):
	return name + " has " + str(hp) + " hp"
